CustomField.description: The date the meter was actually read. FSD 5.10.5 keeps this separate from the bill date. This is the field that orders bills into a consumption sequence, so it, not the bill date, determines which bill is the prior bill.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date the meter reading was taken, as printed on the invoice. Bills are sequenced by this date, so an inaccurate read date will attribute consumption to the wrong period.
CustomField.label: Read Date
